claims.claim: You can apply or do this online.
claims.quote: If you’re filing a return on behalf of your client, you should do this online.
claims.note: Online filing is described only for representatives (solicitors, agents, conveyancers); unrepresented buyers must use the paper SDLT1 return.

claims.claim: You can apply or do this by post.
claims.quote: If you’re not represented, you must use the SDLT1 paper return and send it to HMRC by post.
claims.note: The text says the SDLT1 paper return is sent to HMRC by post.
The text does not mention a completion statement as evidence needed for the return.
